sudoku-generator/features/custom_layout_: Choose 2 or 3 puzzles per row and the sheet fills with as many rows as fit.
sudoku-generator/features/unique_puzzles: All puzzles on a page are guaranteed to be different.
sudoku-generator/features/verified_solut: Every puzzle is generated from a complete solution and double-checked for a unique answer, so it is always solvable.
sudoku-generator/how_to_use/step1: Choose the difficulty level: easy, medium or hard.
sudoku-generator/how_to_use/step2: Pick how many puzzles fit per row; the page fills automatically. Click Generate to create a new set of puzzles.
sudoku-generator/how_to_use/step3: Preview the page; toggle the solution to check the filled answers.
sudoku-generator/how_to_use/step4: Print the A4 page or download it as an image.
sudoku-generator/note: Generate and print random Sudoku puzzles on A4 paper, with selectable difficulty and a page layout that automatically fills the sheet.
